import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, MultiPoint
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query the coordinates of all air quality monitoring stations
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Create a GeoDataFrame from the station coordinates
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude), crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# Create a MultiPoint object from the station coordinates
points = MultiPoint(stations_gdf.geometry)

# Generate the Voronoi diagram
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(points)

# Create a GeoDataFrame from the Voronoi polygons
voronoi_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=[poly for poly in voronoi.geoms], crs="EPSG:4326")

# Clip the Voronoi polygons to the bounding box of the stations
bounding_box = stations_gdf.total_bounds
voronoi_clipped_gdf = voronoi_gdf.intersection(gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=[Point(bounding_box).buffer(0.1)], crs="EPSG:4326"))

# Calculate the area of each Voronoi cell in km²
voronoi_clipped_gdf['area_km2'] = voronoi_clipped_gdf.geometry.to_crs(epsg=3857).area / 1e6

# Merge the Voronoi cells with the station names
voronoi_clipped_gdf = voronoi_clipped_gdf.merge(stations_gdf[['id', 'name_en']], left_index=True, right_index=True)

# Find the largest and smallest Voronoi cells
largest_cell = voronoi_clipped_gdf.loc[voronoi_clipped_gdf['area_km2'].idxmax()]
smallest_cell = voronoi_clipped_gdf.loc[voronoi_clipped_gdf['area_km2'].idxmin()]

# Store the results
largest_cell_station_name = largest_cell['name_en']
largest_cell_area_km2 = round(largest_cell['area_km2'], 1)
smallest_cell_station_name = smallest_cell['name_en']
smallest_cell_area_km2 = round(smallest_cell['area_km2'], 1)

# Print the results
